semantic reuse requires explicit reuse class/admission
Digest equality proves byte equality under the declared digest domain only.
based on causal correctness and reuse-class admission

reuseConcepts.name: EXACT_BYTES_REFERENCE
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Exact old bytes/materialization are candidate evidence only; demand M02 reuse class and exact M06 immutable revision/integrity receipt.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: Same digest never proves semantic identity, owner rights, accepted production or storage permission.

reuseConcepts.name: SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE_REFERENCE
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Compare owner-qualified M02 semantic-reuse class with M04 IR revision and M06 causality instead of hash equality.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: Stochastic generation or changed creative policy can defeat semantic reuse even with matching bytes.

reuseConcepts.name: FACET_DEPENDENCY_SLICE
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Study M02 impact cones, M04 versioned facets and M06 complete dependency indices for a possible minimum sufficient rebuild.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: Unknown/hidden provider input, stale reverse index or moving alias forces an explicit unknown state.

reuseConcepts.name: TEMPORAL_SHOT_AUDIO_SLICE
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Study bounded per-shot/per-frame/per-sample reuse only after future source-qualified composition and synchronization proof.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: Temporal seams, audio sample drift, color continuity, omitted mixed ancestry or altered codec can invalidate a segment.

reuseConcepts.name: IDENTITY_DNA_PROJECTION
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Study reuse of old character, spokesperson, voice or brand projection as a reference to exact M05 protected anchors.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: Changing DNA revision, protected identity, subject consent or cross-modal voice/face alignment can invalidate an old projection.

reuseConcepts.name: EPHEMERAL_TOKEN_PREFIX
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Study provider-local KV/prefix cache as disposable inference optimization only, never production/materialization truth.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: Model, tokenizer, template, context, tenant or rights drift can invalidate ephemeral state even when a prefix hash matches.

reuseConcepts.name: PHYSICAL_CAS_POINTER
reuseConcepts.boundedHypothesis: Study read-only observation of content-addressable bytes but reserve retention, tiering and deletion execution to M55.
reuseConcepts.failureBoundary: An existing object, digest collision or stale pointer grants neither accepted media nor tenant access or GC permission.

strategies.name: NO_CACHE_BASELINE
strategies.hypothesis: Document future full-rebuild baseline with exact source workload and M08 measurement qualification; no reuse admission.

strategies.name: EXACT_MATERIAL_LOOKUP
strategies.hypothesis: Investigate immutable materialization refs and separate owner-issued M02 reuse decision, not automatic CAS hits.

strategies.name: QUALIFIED_SLICE_DELTA
strategies.hypothesis: Investigate M02 causal facet and M04 typed IR slice proof with positive M06 dependency freshness.

strategies.name: MIXED_RECONSTRUCTION
strategies.hypothesis: Investigate positive-proven mixed reused/rebuilt shot, audio, motion and geometry ancestry and recomposition witnesses.

strategies.name: EPHEMERAL_PREFIX_ONLY
strategies.hypothesis: Investigate per-model/per-tenant temporary KV/prefix worksets outside production and durable M55 storage authority.

qualificationAxes.futureOwnerEvidence: Accepted exact graph/branch/immutable revision and genuine owner-issued scoped reuse class, never a mutable display name.
Exact operational revision/materialization/attempt identity and digest algorithm/domain plus source-issued integrity receipts.
Typed IR revision/facet and exact temporal, geometry, color, material and voice projection boundaries.
Actual protected anchor revision and versioned cross-modal identity compatibility, not a matching image or sound hash.
Complete fresh reverse index and hidden/dynamic dependency proof, with explicit unknown on missing mandatory evidence.
Actual class evidence separating exact bytes, semantic equivalence, bounded stochastic replay and irreconstructable outputs.
Independent current quality/fidelity and human-review gate evidence; no stale quality promotion by a cache hit.
Actual versioned model, adapters, workflow, provider, compiler, package/license and materially relevant device context.
Current independently authenticated consent/license/principal/tenant binding with at-use revocation protection.
Actual owner authority for CAS availability, encryption, retention pins, deletion, GC epochs, storage tiers and restoration.
Actual protocol-controlled cold/full versus partial/reused timing, quality and resource-interference evidence.
Separately real coherent all-member M09 grant, authenticated process ACK, attempt fence and qualified platform OS rights.

questions.question: Which exact accepted M02 graph and M06 materialization/revision identity can M13 describe without making a competing build state?
How would the M02 owner issue a scoped reuse class and work disposition independent of a later M13 cache-hit observation?
Which exact M06 digest algorithm, byte domain, operational lineage and independent integrity receipt are mandatory for material lookup?
Which exact M04 IR facet, time span, geometry/material/color and schema revision can a partial reuse hint reference?
Which protected M05 subject/DNA revision and voice-face-brand anchors must match before reusing a prior persona projection?
How do hidden dynamic dependencies and stale reverse indexes forbid a false unchanged-slice assertion?
Which reproducibility receipts can distinguish exact bytes, semantic equivalence and stochastic approximate reconstruction?
Which audio/video sample offsets, shot seams and composition witnesses qualify a future partial media rebuild?
When creative fidelity rules change despite identical bytes, which fresh M01 assessment must precede any master reuse?
Which real current rights, consent, tenant and principal state supersedes historical permissive cache records?
Who owns CAS physical availability, encryption, cache retention, delete completion and storage-tier actions?
How should a newly revoked voice/face consent or broken protected anchor invalidate old M05 identity-linked cache candidates?
Which exact model, tokenizer, template, context, workflow and package version binds an ephemeral KV prefix?
Which real H01-H04 evidence must predate a positive GPU prewarm, rather than treating loaded bytes as a lease?
What positive unchanged-facet proof is needed to distinguish no-work from an unobserved hidden dependency?
Which protected lineage/retention and race-bound GC epoch is necessary before considering any storage cleanup?
Which future empirical protocols distinguish genuine partial reuse benefit from cold cost, quality loss and workstation interference?
How can exact reused/rebuilt ancestry and recomposition receipts preserve immutable master history in a delta rebuild?
Which independently reviewed rights/security/storage receipts must be rechecked at the exact moment a reuse candidate is accessed?
How may a concurrent IR edit, object deletion or branch-head movement invalidate an older lookup without an implicit latest ref?

futureNegativeCases.label: HASH_NOT_SEMANTICS
futureNegativeCases.trigger: Byte-identical media appears under distinct accepted M02 semantic revisions.

futureNegativeCases.label: STALE_QUALITY
futureNegativeCases.trigger: An old cached image has no valid quality decision under new M01 fidelity rules.

futureNegativeCases.label: HIDDEN_DEPENDENCY
futureNegativeCases.trigger: A provider used undeclared material input while a stale reverse index says unchanged.

futureNegativeCases.label: STOCHASTIC_DIVERGENCE
futureNegativeCases.trigger: The same seed exists but model/runtime changes make exact replay unsupported.

futureNegativeCases.label: VIDEO_SEAM
futureNegativeCases.trigger: A reused shot fragment changes frame color or camera continuity at recomposition.

futureNegativeCases.label: AUDIO_SYNC
futureNegativeCases.trigger: A reused voice clip shifts sample time or beats against updated video.

futureNegativeCases.label: DNA_ANCHOR
futureNegativeCases.trigger: An old persona render remains cached after a protected identity anchor changes.

futureNegativeCases.label: RIGHTS_REVOKED
futureNegativeCases.trigger: Source consent/license was revoked since the historic materialization receipt.

futureNegativeCases.label: CROSS_TENANT
futureNegativeCases.trigger: Equal digest across two tenants is mistaken for permission to share private intermediate bytes.

futureNegativeCases.label: KV_INCOMPATIBLE
futureNegativeCases.trigger: Prefix state is reused across incompatible model, tokenizer, prompt template or context.

futureNegativeCases.label: GPU_HINT_ONLY
futureNegativeCases.trigger: Observed warm VRAM is mistaken for a valid live joint M09 lease and M11 ACK.

futureNegativeCases.label: OBJECT_DELETED
futureNegativeCases.trigger: An apparent CAS object was already physically deleted when a stale cache lookup occurs.

futureNegativeCases.label: GC_EPOCH
futureNegativeCases.trigger: Protected reachability changes between deletion eligibility and physical delete.

futureNegativeCases.label: MOVING_ALIAS
futureNegativeCases.trigger: A branch alias moves during cache lookup and is mistaken for an immutable graph reference.

futureNegativeCases.label: MASTER_PROMOTION
futureNegativeCases.trigger: A positive reuse hint is mistaken for M01 accepted master/release authorization.

futureNegativeCases.label: MIXED_ANCESTRY
futureNegativeCases.trigger: A partial rebuild loses reused/rebuilt lineage and overwrites an old immutable master.

stop: S03 is nonbinding source-only cache/delta research. No physical storage, cache engine, semantic equivalence, owner-issued reuse class, actual M02/M06 reuse admission, M01 quality promotion, rights/security contract, GPU grant, process/OS/network/cloud rights or M10/M11/M12/M13 runtime are authorized. H01-H04 remain OPEN HIGH, B DIRECTION_ONLY, C01 UNADOPTED_NOT_FROZEN; all original and new future negative cases remain SPECIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED.
